title: Unlock Powerful Insights with Spyglass
summary: Spyglass has officially moved from beta to launch, providing a robust suite of enhanced tools designed to empower you with deeper, actionable insights.

title: New File Management Tools
summary: We've released powerful new file management tools in the editor, giving you complete control to upload, remove, download, and customize how your images and documents appear.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past accomplishments, upcoming features, and long-term vision for the product.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, effortlessly clickable, and fully draggable for seamless task management.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive real-time editing experience when collaborating with your team.

title: Enhanced Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Now, effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with friends, making teamwork more intuitive and powerful.

title: Enhanced Global Language Support
summary: We're expanding Noeko to include robust support for multiple international languages, welcoming users from around the world.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower you with greater control, foster community involvement, and ensure maximum transparency in our development journey.

title: Personalized Knowledge Explorer
summary: Unlock a more powerful and personalized knowledge exploration experience with dynamic filters and integrated workflows in your Constellation view.

title: Enhanced Search and Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your essential information using advanced filtering, custom sorting, and the ability to save personalized knowledge collections.

title: Flexible Content Displays
summary: Get ready for a smarter way to structure your thoughts with new display modes for connected content, designed to match your unique thinking style.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting & Flexible Premium Plans
summary: We are excited to introduce Noeko's new self-hosting capability and premium plans, offering unparalleled flexibility and powerful features for teams of all sizes.

title: Enhanced Time-Sensitive Greetings
summary: We're updating our welcome messages to always display the correct time of day, ensuring a more accurate and personalized experience for every user.

title: Quick Actions for Your Tagged Items
summary: Experience a major boost in productivity as you gain the power to effortlessly manage and organize your tagged items, directly from your list views.

title: Unlock More Information Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate and engage with a broader spectrum of content formats, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to build your comprehensive knowledge base.
